newsitem.title: USA: Tennant sees Q4 sales, earnings gains.
newsitem.headline: Tennant sees Q4 sales, earnings gains.

text.p: Tennant Co said Tuesday it expects increasing gross margins in the fourth quarter and, in turn. a rise in earnings.
The company today reported third quarter earnings of $0.50 a share versus $0.47 last year on strong consolidated orders and expense controls.

"We believe we can stay on this track for the foreseeable future, and we anticipate an improvement in gross margins from third quarter on higher sales and assuming a more favorable product mix and stable dollar," Roger Hale, chief executive, said in a statement.
"This should allow us to report sales and earnings gains for the fourth quarter," he said.
Beyond the fourth quarter, Hale said he expects the company to show steady progress toward achieving its goal of a 10 percent operating margin.
